question: When an article is sold for ₹388, there is a loss of 3%. What is the selling price (in ₹) of the article, if it is sold at a gain of 8%?
solution:

At 3% loss selling price of the article = ₹388

**Formula used:**

L = CP - SP

P = SP - CP Where, L = Loss, P = Profite, SP = Selling price, and CP = Cost price
